From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, security@acme.com

Subject: SIG Questionnaire - Next steps & clarifying Qs

Hi Raj —

Great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance side so we can keep the procurement review moving: 

Call recap
- Scope: Acme is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing search feature (production workloads).
- Key asks from your side: SOC 2 evidence, CAIQ/SIG completion, and clarification on data residency and PHI/HIPAA scope.

Next steps (requested)
1) I attached a simple worksheet (Acme_SIG_Request.xlsx) and our short guide (Redwood_SIG_Guide.pdf) to help accelerate the SIG/CAIQ answers — can you have your security or procurement team fill the CAIQ columns where possible?
2) We'll provide SOC 2 Type II report and any supporting docs after NDA (we can share limited-view links).
3) If you need a BAA, please confirm whether Acme will be sending PHI through the integration.

Clarifying questions for you (to speed up our internal review)
- Is the in-scope environment production only, or do you need answers for staging/pre-prod?
- Will Acme require US-only data residency?
- Do you need customer-managed KMS (HSM) for key control, or is provider-managed KMS acceptable?

Timeline: if we get the CAIQ back in 5-7 business days we can aim to have the security review completed and surface any open items.

Thanks — looping in Marissa (CS) and Nikhil (security) for the technical follow-up.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Thanks Camila — appreciate the recap. A few quick clarifications from our side before we start filling out the sheet: 

1) SOC 2: Is Redwood SOC 2 Type II? If so, what is the reporting period and date of most recent audit?
2) HIPAA/PHI: Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA if Acme processes PHI?
3) Encryption: we need details on encryption at rest (algorithms, KMS options) and in transit.
4) Attachments: we typically return a partially-completed CAIQ and then follow up on outstanding questions — fine to proceed that way?

Also, does Redwood require signatures on a separate NDA before you share the SOC 2 report, or can you provide a limited-view link to our security contact?

I'll route the CAIQ worksheet to our security team and get it back to you.

Raj — thanks, quick answers inline below to unblock you while Nikhil prepares the detailed technical responses: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. Our most recent report covers 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (audit issued 2026-02-15). We can provide a redacted/ltd-view link for your security team.
2) BAA/HIPAA: Redwood can sign a BAA where customers process PHI. Please confirm whether Acme will be sending PHI so we can route to Legal.
3) Encryption: short version — AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated/Private deployments. Nikhil will add specifics on KMS/HSM options and rotation.
4) CAIQ workflow: absolutely fine for you to return a partially-completed CAIQ/worksheet; we'll follow up on the questions you leave open.

Next steps: Nikhil (security) will follow up with the technical answers and any attachments we can share (SOC 2 link, key management docs). If you confirm PHI, we'll also loop in Legal for a draft BAA.

Best,
Camila

Hi Raj — copying the team. Below are the technical answers to the items you flagged, and one question back to you at the end.

Technical responses (summary)
- SOC 2: Type II (report period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Audit issued 2026-02-15. We can provide a limited-access link to the report; let me know the email(s) to grant access.
- Encryption at rest: AES-256. For Hosted API we use provider-managed KMS by default; Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS w/ optional CloudHSM). Key rotation: supported and configurable per deployment.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ (recommend TLS 1.3 where supported).
- Data residency: Default hosted region is US; we support EU and APAC regions for Dedicated/Private deployments. Tell us which region(s) Acme requires.
- Logging & audit: API request logs, admin audit logs, and token-level usage logs are available for SRE/CS review; retention windows vary by plan — we can discuss retention requirements.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a subprocessors list and will provide the current list on request (we typically allow customers to review before contract execution).

Attachments we can provide once access is confirmed: SOC2_TypeII_2025_restricted.pdf (limited view), Redwood_SIG_Guide.pdf (attached by Camila).

One question for Acme: Will Acme be sending any PHI to Redwood as part of the integration? If yes, state the data categories and we will initiate the BAA/legal path.

If it's helpful, we can setup a 30-min technical deep-dive this week to walk through the SIG/CAIQ items you find most relevant.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
